versions.content: DRAFT If ComMDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE on at least one channel , when passed parameters match (see [SWS_ComM_01038] ) and PNC lear ning phase is not active, then the function ComM_UpdatePncMappingTable shall merge for all PNCs the provided information with their current PNC - to - channel mappings whereby MappingTable shall be interpreted as a two - dimensional array with on first dimension all ComM channels where ComMPncGatewayType is set are handled according to their derived order in ComM and on second dimension all configured ComMPnc according to their order given by their ComMPncId. Additionally it shall return with E_OK.
